categories.main_business_segments: The company is a professional provider of comprehensive backlight display module solutions. Its primary business segments include: (1) consumer electronics backlight display modules for smartphones, tablets, and notebooks as the foundational business; (2) automotive display modules and LIPO (ultra-narrow bezel) technology for OLED displays as core growth businesses; and (3) emerging businesses including AR/VR display solutions and precision structural components for new intelligent hardware terminals.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed proprietary technologies including ultra-thin ultra-high brightness LGP compression molding, ultra-short light path backlight modules, line light source (COB) backlight modules, and asymmetric backlight modules. It has accumulated 543 patent applications (155 invention patents) with 417 authorized patents. The company specializes in Mini-LED and Micro-LED display technologies, with 167 effective Mini-LED related patents and 26 Micro-LED related patents. Production employs a make-to-order model with customized batch manufacturing capabilities.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include major LCD display module manufacturers (BOE, TCL, Tianma, Innolux, Long Shin) and Tier 1 automotive suppliers (Continental, Faurecia, Visteon, Mobis, Desay SV). End-market customers include leading automotive brands (BYD, NIO, XPeng, Li Auto, SAIC, Geely, GAC, Ford, Hyundai, Toyota, Honda) and consumer electronics brands (Samsung, Huawei, Xiaomi, vivo, OPPO, Transsion, Meta). The company serves smartphone, tablet, notebook, automotive display, VR/AR, and smart wearable markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in mainland China with manufacturing facilities in Shenzhen, Huizhou, and Xiamen. It has established international presence through subsidiaries including Balong High-Tech (Hong Kong) and Longli Technology (India). The company serves customers across North China, East China, South China, Central China, and Southwest China regions, with overseas sales representing approximately 5.83% of total revenue.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream of the LED display industry supply chain, positioned between upstream LED chip and material suppliers and downstream LCD display module manufacturers and automotive Tier 1 suppliers. It provides integrated backlight display module solutions including optical design, component manufacturing, assembly, and quality assurance services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic focus emphasizes technology-driven innovation with R&D investment of 56.2 million yuan (4.26% of revenue). Key R&D directions include: (1) Mini-LED technology advancement for automotive and consumer applications; (2) LIPO ultra-narrow bezel technology for OLED displays; (3) Micro-LED technology development for AR applications; (4) AR/VR display solutions; and (5) precision structural components for AI-enabled smart hardware. The company established a Precision Industrial Division in 2024 to pursue emerging intelligent hardware opportunities.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of backlight display modules to LCD display module manufacturers and automotive Tier 1 suppliers. Revenue recognition occurs when customers receive goods (for standard transactions) or when customers use products and both parties reconcile accounts (for VMI supply arrangements). The company maintains long-term stable relationships with customers following initial qualification and certification processes.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include Radiant Opto-Electronics (Taiwan), Minebea Group (Japan), Dongguan Sanxie Precision Technology, Weizhi Holdings (Hong Kong-listed), Baoming Technology (SZ:002992), and Nanjiguang Electronics (SZ:300940). The company positions itself as a leading domestic backlight display module provider with advanced Mini-LED technology capabilities, strong customer relationships with major OEMs, and comprehensive integrated manufacturing capabilities. It ranks among the top domestic competitors in the LCD backlight module industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company achieved 2024 revenue of 1.32 billion yuan, representing 28.64% year-over-year growth from 1.03 billion yuan in 2023. Net profit attributable to shareholders was 106.4 million yuan in 2024, up 132.9% from 45.7 million yuan in 2023. The company demonstrates strong recovery trajectory with operating cash flow of 347.7 million yuan in 2024 versus negative 150.7 million yuan in 2023. Total assets reached 1.98 billion yuan with shareholders' equity of 1.18 billion yuan as of December 31, 2024.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through: (1) advanced Mini-LED technology with superior optical performance and cost efficiency; (2) comprehensive integrated manufacturing capabilities spanning optical design, precision molding, assembly, and quality assurance; (3) strong R&D capabilities with 344 R&D personnel and extensive patent portfolio; (4) established relationships with leading global OEMs providing stable long-term business; (5) innovative LIPO technology for next-generation OLED displays; and (6) emerging capabilities in AR/VR displays and precision structural components for AI-enabled devices. The company emphasizes quality excellence, technological innovation, and rapid customer response capabilities.
